description: Resolve 1..1000 texts against one concept type. mint=false returns exact/matched/would_mint outcomes without minting; mint=true creates misses and requires owner (reporting requires editor). Resolution can call embeddings and the identity judge even in report mode. Review would_mint rows before authorizing creation. A new type may be initialized with embedding_model; existing types cannot switch spaces through import. Returns per-text outcomes. See enricher://docs/semantic-ids.

embedding_model.description: Composite key (provider::model) seeding a NEW concept type's slice — an import may open the type it resolves into. Refused when that type's vocabulary already lives in another model.
embedding_model.title: Embedding Model

judge_floor.description: Similarity at or above which a candidate is put to the identity judge. Omit to use the organization default (Settings → Organization).
judge_floor.title: Judge Floor

mint.description: False = report only; True = create the unmatched rows (owner role).
mint.title: Mint

name: import_semantic_concepts
title: Import semantic concepts
